findings.reason: SpreadsheetScrollGrid reload race on a live update (useEntityChanged → reloadKey): the reload effect clears `rows` and bumps `generation` but leaves the OLD `shape` in state while the new fetchShape is in flight. The fill effect then sees `loaded === 0` with the stale shape and calls loadNext under the NEW generation using the old nRows/nCols. When the new shape lands, its loadNext returns early because inFlight is set, so the stale-sized window is the one that gets appended. If the sheet shrank, r2 can go past the new nRows and the route refuses it, which shows a false 'Rows a–b could not be read.' banner and stops scrolling. If columns were added, the first window's rows come back short. Fix: reset `shape` to undefined (or hold off loading until the fresh shape arrives) before the first window of a reload is fetched.

The 'rows held do not fill the box' top-up runs only when `loaded`/`shape` change. If the viewport grows after the last window arrived (window resize, devtools closed) so that every loaded row fits, the box stops scrolling, no scroll event fires, and the remaining rows cannot be reached. That contradicts 'scrollable through the whole sheet' (s7ao66dy). Re-checking on resize (ResizeObserver on the box) would close the gap.
